billing.scope: Public app routes, method/authentication boundary, request fields and response DTOs; provider/environment effects remain separately pending. Server implementation files unchanged in the acceptance worktree.

auth-profile.scope: Profile GET/PUT, linked-provider reads, session listing and activity list/detail/types/JSON+CSV export: registered routes, JWT/RBAC boundaries, request fields, response DTOs and export cap. Provider login and environment effects remain separate.

ai.scope: Public authenticated catalog/generation/file routes and DTOs; first-frame WebSocket auth; single start with tool_result continuation after server state is ready, terminal/cancellation ordering. Checksums include the uncommitted NSDK-03 server correction. Provider/device/environment effects remain pending.

auth-entry.scope: Sixteen public entry operations: password/OTP registration and login, refresh/logout, reset and verification mail, magic link; actual methods, app binding, request DTOs, primary MFA/enrollment and expired-password/error response shapes. Email delivery, token storage/session concurrency, provider/device and environment acceptance remain separate. Server implementation files are unchanged.

sync.scope: Actual app-bound JWT routes and grant checks; user/workspace bootstrap visibility, per-request scoped grants, immutable ownership/CAS, partial idempotent mutations, opaque cursor/snapshot DTOs and fixed watermarks. Native lifecycle/local-store adaptations have explicit synthetic tests. Environment, live retention and physical acceptance remain separate. Server implementation unchanged in this review.

auth-mfa.scope: 24 direct MFA/phone/backup-email/trusted-device HTTP operations: methods, authorization requirements, request fields and response DTOs. NSDK-06 corrects SMS method flags and selects persisted Email2FAEnabled via the Application ORM model; hashes identify the pending server implementation. No provider delivery or environment acceptance inferred.

auth-account.scope: 22 account/configuration and raw WebAuthn HTTP operations: actual routes, request bodies, app/JWT requirements, response envelopes, MFA restrictions, session revocation and credential UUIDs. Seven additional synthetic fixtures include real Go WebAuthn option types. System UI, provider delivery, device and environment acceptance remain separate.

session.scope: Native adaptations of token access, activation and clearing: one AuthSession owner, profile-confirmed identity, generation-bound token providers, durable Keychain activation fence and shared refresh. Explicit existing synthetic concurrency/fault tests; not new physical or environment acceptance.

http-extension.scope: Native HTTP transport adaptations for Auth and Billing generic request extensions. Runtime routes remain defined by each service. Reserved/control header validation, cancellation and explicit errors/no retry have synthetic transport tests. No live transport or provider acceptance inferred.
